_comment: Structural numbers that scripts/check_report_numbers.py (DESIGN §13.5) does not require a source for. Each entry: id, regex (matched on the report line; a number lying inside a match is exempt) and reason. Results are never exempt: keep this list short and structural.

exemptions.reason: publication and calendar years (citations such as Tsherniak 2017)
row numbering in a table's first column
top-k list sizes defined in DESIGN §6.1 / §10.5 (primary_endpoints.json: P2 k = 200, secondary 100 / 500)
null draw counts defined in DESIGN §7.1-§7.2 (B 20, raised 50; rerun 10)
confidence level of every interval in DESIGN (95%)
thresholds of frozen DESIGN rules stated as inequalities (q < 0.05, >= 5 carriers, share >= 0.25); observed results are written with '=' or plainly and must be cited
report layout defined in DESIGN §12.3 (top 15 shortlist rows, three case studies)
